_doc: What the Cems can build (story/STORY.md: the 3D printers print with living things; you pick a design and the Cems build it on command). Each design is a small voxel model made of parts (src/world/voxel.ts): box, gable (a pitched roof, ridge along x or y), hip (four sloped sides), dome (half an ellipsoid), cyl (an upright cylinder), cone, carve (takes voxels away) and paint (recolors what is there), each over [x, y, z, w, d, h] in voxels (x to the right, y from the front to the back, z up; a voxel is ppv px wide in the world, 4 tiles = 16 voxels), with a material; repeat n with step [dx, dy, dz] copies a part. Nothing about a design's price is written by hand: volume is how many voxels it has, complexity comes from its parts (costing.weights per part, repeats counted), how many materials it mixes (matWeight) and its fine materials (special per voxel); every material voxel costs what costing.perVoxel says (lignin is Cems, salt and iron layered; glass is quartz; wire is copper; a core is Ember), all of it times 1 + complexity x markup; wood is the ants' and fungus' feed (woodPerComplexity), and the print takes (baseSeconds + volume x secondsPerVoxel) x (1 + complexity x secondsPerComplexity), less nurseryCut for every Cem Nursery standing. tiers name the complexity. needs: designs that must stand on this world first. place post: it stands at a free street lamp spot of the town (town.json posts) instead of taking a lot. place bed: printed on the Cem bed itself, a thing you carry rather than a building (the Nous Chip: it lies on the bed until you walk onto it, src/entities/Chips.ts). gives: what it does once built (house: mood, storehouse: storage, nursery: print speed; nouschip: the mind every new Vessel needs at the Replicator; the rest open other designs). materials: color ramps (palette indexes: light, mid, dark; alt = the ramp of every other layer, so lignin shows its metal-like laminations), glass is see-through, emissive ones light up at night. view: the in-world camera (pitch in degrees, ppv) and the menu's turntable (pitch, degrees a second).

designs.name: Cem Lantern
designs.about: A post of lignin with an Ember core behind quartz: the first thing every Cem bed learns.

designs.name: House
designs.gives: A HOME: EVERY VESSEL HERE FEELS IT
designs.about: Lignin walls, two warm windows and a living roof of Cems that never stopped growing.

designs.name: Storehouse
designs.gives: THE STORE HOLDS 20 MORE OF EACH
designs.about: A long low hall with wide doors and a green roof, where the ants stack what you bring.

designs.name: Cem Nursery
designs.gives: CEMS GROW FASTER: EVERY PRINT A QUARTER QUICKER
designs.about: A glasshouse over trays of young Cems, ribbed in copper so it rings a little in the wind.

designs.name: Workshop
designs.gives: OPENS THE OBSERVATORY AND THE SIGNAL SPIRE
designs.about: A tall bay door, a forge glow over it and a copper stack: where the finer prints are worked out.

designs.name: Observatory
designs.gives: WATCHES THE SKY; OPENS THE BIOLAB
designs.about: A round tower under a steel dome, its quartz lens turned to the stars the Vessels went to.

designs.name: Signal Spire
designs.gives: CALLS ACROSS THE STARS; OPENS THE SUPERCOMPUTER
designs.about: A needle of lignin wound with copper, an Ember light at its tip that blinks to the nine.

designs.name: Biolab
designs.gives: STUDIES THE CEMS; OPENS THE SUPERCOMPUTER
designs.about: Two glass domes over vats of Cems, joined by copper pipes: where the next strains are grown.

designs.name: Supercomputer
designs.gives: THE FIRST THINKING MACHINE: OPENS THE NOUS CHIP
designs.about: Racks of dark composite behind steel, copper fins to cool it, and an Ember core under a quartz crown.

designs.name: Nous Chip
designs.gives: A VESSEL'S MIND: EVERY NEW VESSEL NEEDS ONE
designs.about: Quartz grown over a core of Ember, wired in copper: the mind the Replicator gives each new Vessel. You carry it.
